name: MacBook Air 13-inch (M2, 2022)
source_title: Apple Support: MacBook Air (13-inch, M2, 2022) - Technical Specifications
excerpt: Two Thunderbolt / USB 4 ports with support for Charging, DisplayPort, Thunderbolt 3 (up to 40Gb/s), USB 4 (up to 40Gb/s). Simultaneously supports full native resolution on the built-in display at 1 billion colors and one external display with up to 6K resolution at 60Hz. 30W USB-C Power Adapter included with base model; fast-charge capable with 67W USB-C Power Adapter.
